Market today: The market is grappling with strong economic data (GDP revision) but also a clear over-reliance on the semiconductor sector, dubbed "the new oil." This concentration, especially around names like Nvidia, creates both opportunity and significant risk for your tech-heavy book.

Your holdings: Your leveraged chip ETFs, SOXL (-85.75%) and MUU (-74.64%), are in critical condition with stops completely ignored. SMCI (-46.88%) and SMH (-33.62%) also show deep losses. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the broader semiconductor sector's performance and any shifts in sentiment around key chip leaders. Also, monitor your leveraged positions for any further decay.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage risk in your deeply underwater, leveraged positions before considering new opportunities.
plays: SOXL & MUU: Your stops are completely broken. Consider exiting these leveraged positions to prevent further decay and capital erosion.
SMCI & SMH: These chip ETFs are deeply underwater. Respect your stops or consider trimming to reduce exposure to a sector already showing significant weakness in your book.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
